transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess... I'm just having a hard time sitting still. Like, whenever I'm supposed to just stay put in the radiology suite, or in my classes... I don't know, I just feel like I'm crawling out of my skin. I've tried to just tough it out for months now, but... I always end up pacing, or shifting around, or just finding some excuse to get up and move.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications, or have you recently started or changed any?
No. Um... I'm not taking anything.
Does this uncomfortable feeling or urge to move primarily affect your legs?
Um, no... not really. I don't think so. It's not just my legs, it's kind of... everywhere, I guess. I just feel like I need to move.
Have you had this kind of restlessness and difficulty sitting still since you were a child, or did it start more recently?

Um... I guess it's always been like this. It's not recent. 

My parents... they still bring up elementary school conferences. Teachers would say I was always getting out of my seat, or... calling out. Rushing ahead before they even finished giving directions. So... yeah, it was happening way before middle school. It's not just something that started with my radiology training.
In addition to the restlessness, do you also struggle with sustaining your attention or staying focused on tasks?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I can focus on things okay.
Do you find yourself struggling with persistent, excessive worry about everyday events or activities?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't think I worry too much about things. Just normal stuff, I guess.
